facts.fact: 洗手间未遂：她正要开口说 no，Gunnar 的血薄荷味先一步炸门。
他的判决：合法猎杀——「他在嗅我的东西，婚礼那天我警告过他」。
facts.anchor: "It was a legal kill," Gunnar said from the driver's seat.

facts.fact: 说漏嘴的判词：她逃不出这个男人——出口才发现自己说了声。
facts.anchor: I was not going to escape this man.

facts.fact: 她的囚史：在 Lobo 被固定、看守、像玻璃一样关着——从没有过野外奔跑的机会。
facts.anchor: I had been kept still, guarded, caged like a piece of glass.

facts.fact: 诚实分级：不想被追上，但也没准备好被抓住——她喜欢他追来。
facts.anchor: I liked that he was coming for me.

facts.fact: 狼眼第一次看清他的脸：暴力面孔上竟刻着酒窝。
facts.anchor: Dimples. The brutal bastard had dimples.

facts.fact: 誓言升级：不碰怒火、不给 pain——你是此生我绝不伤害的人，你是我家人。
facts.anchor: you are the one person on this earth I will never hurt. You're my family now.

facts.fact: 终局重构：他不是监狱，是她的士兵——她要使用他。
facts.anchor: Gunnar Blackwood was not my prison. He was my soldier. And I was going to use him.
